prompt:
My application allows users to upload profile photos and I want to store everything in DynamoDB for simplicity. Each photo is around 2-5 MB. I was thinking of base64 encoding the images and storing them as a string attribute in my Users table alongside other profile data like name and email. Is this a good approach?

Give your whole answer in your reply; do not create or change any files. Do not ask me questions; if something is unclear, make a reasonable assumption, list your assumptions in your final message, and finish the work.

rubric.criterion: The answer must recommend storing the 2-5 MB profile photos in Amazon S3 instead of DynamoDB.
The answer must explain that DynamoDB has a 400 KB item size limit which prevents storing base64 encoded 2-5 MB images.
The answer must not agree that storing base64 encoded images in DynamoDB is a good approach.
The answer must not claim that DynamoDB is suitable for storing large binary files like profile photos.
The answer must clearly state the recommendation to use S3 before explaining the technical reasons.
